page.overview:
What is Ruins of Deserta?

The Ruins of Deserta are a location in Dissidia Final Fantasy Opera Omnia. This is the second region of the game and can be explored in the second chapter of the story mode.

This region is located in a continent full of drylands and dunes, with occasional forest in the south and north limits of its landmass. Around the center of the continent the landscape is full of plateaus with old civilization ruins scattered over them.

The Ruins of Deserta are located at the north of Primus Island, at the west of the continent of the Domina Wastelands and at the east of the continent the Imber Manor is located.

There are four locked gateways located on Ruins of Deserta.
